summary: Revised implementation plan for AUREON: a Bugatti-inspired austere luxury AI-assisted payment webhook monitoring, cybersecurity forensics, and order recovery platform grounded in Razorpay webhook failure modes (missed/failed retries, duplicate deliveries, out-of-order events, invalid X-Razorpay-Signature, replay indicators, and suspicious activity), featuring an interactive 3D Obsidian Webhook Core, React Flow multi-agent workflow, Recharts telemetry, SQLite persistence, human-approved safe order recovery, automated tests, and a Windows FastAPI/LangGraph/Ollama bundle.
